source_claim: The official Sakura Wars series character directory for Shin Sakura Wars provides an individual profile for Amamiya Sakura, identifies her as a member of the Imperial Assault Force Flower Division, and labels the entry with Shin Sakura Wars.
notes: The character profile and exact Issue 70 Japanese label establish only Amamiya Sakura; the older Sakura Shinguji is a distinct character and is not conflated.
